vocabulary_concerns: The three Boolean facts express alternative connective structures, but cannot express whether the stated threshold is merely necessary or legally sufficient. A necessary-only interpretation leaves the actual trigger underdetermined.

“That business” makes hong_kong dependent on identifying the relevant business. The vocabulary supplies no rule for an absent business or unknown location; neither should silently be assigned a truth value.

The case-specific business classification, ordinary-course qualification, regulatory intent and incorporated authority cannot be independently represented by these three facts. They remain external qualifications rather than additional encoded exceptions.
